name: 2unemployment
description: Singapore full-time new-grad software engineering jobs

scripts.build: wrangler types && astro check && astro build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run check && npm run catalog:publish && wrangler deploy
scripts.catalog:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply 2unemployment-catalog --local --config wrangler.jsonc && npm run catalog:export && wrangler d1 execute 2unemployment-catalog --local --config wrangler.jsonc --file .wrangler/catalog-import.sql --yes
scripts.catalog:publish: wrangler d1 migrations apply 2unemployment-catalog --remote --config wrangler.jsonc && npm run catalog:export && wrangler d1 execute 2unemployment-catalog --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --file .wrangler/catalog-import.sql --yes
